title: Zooming out of AdS$_4 \times$S$^2 \times$S$^2$: The Branes behind the CFT's
summary: We reveal the supersymmetric brane configurations that give rise to AdS$_4\times$S$^2\times$S$^2$ supergravity solutions, which are holographic duals to three-dimensional $N=4$ CFTs or to conformal boundaries and domain walls of four-dimensional $N=4$ SYM. We show that these solutions preserve the same Killing spinors as orthogonal D3, D5 and NS5 branes in flat space, and that the singular sources of these solutions correspond to semi-infinite D3-D5 and D3-NS5 spikes.
